name: Chase Card PlayTest
summary:
Chase Card PlayTest 
You play as a father on a mission, the mission is to help your son collect all the Emcards for his Embook collection. Emcards have just released there new set to the world and by any means possable you will try and collect them all. 
Contains 2 Levels from the main game, plus minigames
Please leave Feedback/Review and shape the future of the game before release.
